title: LLM-Integrated Bayesian State Space Models for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2510.20952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forecasting in the real world requires integrating structured time-series data with unstructured textual information, but existing methods are architecturally limited by fixed input/output horizons and are unable to model or quantify uncertainty. We address this challenge by introducing LLM-integrated Bayesian State space models (LBS), a novel probabilistic framework for multimodal temporal forecasting. At a high level, LBS consists of two components: (1) a state space model (SSM) backbone that captures the temporal dynamics of latent states from which both numerical and textual observations are generated and (2) a pretrained large language model (LLM) that is adapted to encode textual inputs for posterior state estimation and decode textual forecasts consistent with the latent trajectory. translated_title: 面向多模态时间序列预测的大语言模型集成贝叶斯状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的预测需要将结构化的时间序列数据与非结构化的文本信息相结合，但现有方法在架构上受限于固定的输入/输出时间窗口，且无法对不确定性进行建模或量化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了LLM集成贝叶斯状态空间模型（LBS），这是一种新颖的多模态时间预测概率框架。在高层次上，LBS由两个组件构成：（1）一个状态空间模型（SSM）骨干，用于捕捉潜在状态的时间动态，数值型和文本型观测均由这些潜在状态生成；（2）一个经预训练的大语言模型（LLM），它被适配用于编码文本输入以进行后验状态估计，并解码出与潜在轨迹保持一致的文本预测。这一设计实现了灵活的回看与预测窗口、有原则的不确定性量化，并借助……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将贝叶斯状态空间模型与大语言模型相融合的LBS框架，实现了能够融合文本信息、灵活设定预测窗口并量化不确定性的多模态时间序列预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LBS, a novel probabilistic framework integrating Bayesian state space models with LLMs, enabling multimodal time-series forecasting that incorporates textual information, supports flexible lookback and forecast windows, and provides principled uncertainty quantification.
